41.name: Combustion
41.d: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

41.name: Fire Power
41.d: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 3% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

41.name: Blast Wave
41.d: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

41.name: Critical Mass
41.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 10%.

41.name: Master of Elements
41.d: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

41.name: Heating Up
41.d: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.

41.name: Improved Fire Ward
41.d: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

41.name: Improved Scorch
41.d: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

41.name: Burning Soul
41.d: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

41.name: Pyroblast
41.d: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

41.name: Improved Flamestrike
41.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 15%.

41.name: Impact
41.d: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

41.name: Flame Throwing
41.d: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

41.name: Ignite
41.d: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

41.name: Improved Fireball
41.d: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball and Frostfire Bolt spells by 0.5 sec.

41.name: Incineration
41.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 6%.

41.name: Improved Fire Blast
41.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec and increases its range by 15 yards.

61.name: Ice Barrier
61.d: Instantly shields you, absorbing 448 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.

61.name: Winter's Chill
61.d: Gives your Frost damage spells a 100% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the damage done by your Cone of Cold spell to the target by 40%, stacking up to 5 times.

61.name: Fingers of Frost
61.d: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

61.name: Improved Cone of Cold
61.d: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 35%.

61.name: Cold Snap
61.d: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

61.name: Ice Lance
61.d: Deals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 200% increased damage to Frozen targets.

61.name: Shatter
61.d: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

61.name: Ice Block
61.d: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

61.name: Arctic Reach
61.d: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

61.name: Improved Blizzard
61.d: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

61.name: Frost Channeling
61.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

61.name: Piercing Ice
61.d: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 6%.

61.name: Frostbite
61.d: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

61.name: Improved Frost Nova
61.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

61.name: Permafrost
61.d: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

61.name: Ice Shards
61.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

61.name: Elemental Precision
61.d: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 5%.

61.name: Improved Frostbolt
61.d: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt and Frost Blast spells by 0.5 sec.

61.name: Frost Warding
61.d: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

81.name: Arcane Power
81.d: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

81.name: Arcane Instability
81.d: Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

81.name: Arcane Mind
81.d: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

81.name: Presence of Mind
81.d: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

81.name: Missile Barrage
81.d: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, your Arcane Missile hits a 10% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

81.name: Arcane Meditation
81.d: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

81.name: Improved Counterspell
81.d: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

81.name: Arcane Shielding
81.d: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

81.name: Arcane Blast
81.d: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 15% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 15 sec from time of initial application.

81.name: Arcane Impact
81.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

81.name: Arcane Geometry
81.d: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

81.name: Arcane Resilience
81.d: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.

81.name: Arcane Concentration
81.d: Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

81.name: Magic Absorption
81.d: Increases all your resistances by 10 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 2% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

81.name: Arcane Subtlety
81.d: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

81.name: Improved Channeling
81.d: Gives you a 100% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 70% chance while casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Wrath.

81.name: Arcane Focus
81.d: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 5%.

81.name: Wand Specialization
81.d: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

81.name: Arcane Wrath
81.d: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 122 to 146 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

161.name: Mortal Strike
161.d: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

161.name: Improved Hamstring
161.d: Gives your Hamstring ability a 15% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

161.name: Weaponmaster
161.d: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Polearm: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.

161.name: Sweeping Strikes
161.d: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

161.name: Impale
161.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.

161.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
161.d: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 3%.

161.name: Spearing Strike
161.d: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

161.name: Deep Wounds
161.d: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 60% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

161.name: Anger Management
161.d: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

161.name: Improved Overpower
161.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

161.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
161.d: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

161.name: Improved Charge
161.d: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 6.

161.name: Improved Rend
161.d: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 35%.

161.name: Improved Heroic Strike
161.d: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 3 Rage.

161.name: Bloodthrill
161.d: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a 20% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.

161.name: Improved Slam
161.d: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.

163.name: Shield Slam
163.d: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

163.name: Focused Rage
163.d: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.

163.name: Bastion
163.d: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

163.name: Improved Shield Bash
163.d: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

163.name: Improved Shield Wall
163.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 11.0 min.

163.name: Vanguard
163.d: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

163.name: Improved Disarm
163.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

163.name: Improved Sunder Armor
163.d: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.

163.name: Improved Revenge
163.d: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

163.name: Last Stand
163.d: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

163.name: Master of Defense
163.d: Grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

163.name: Improved Thunder Clap
163.d: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

163.name: Improved Bloodrage
163.d: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

163.name: Shield Specialization
163.d: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

163.name: Defiance
163.d: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.

163.name: Iron Will
163.d: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

164.name: Improved Intercept
164.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

164.name: Death Wish
164.d: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

164.name: Flurry
164.d: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

164.name: Bloodthirst
164.d: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

164.name: Enrage
164.d: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 10% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

164.name: Improved Execute
164.d: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

164.name: Dual Wield Specialization
164.d: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%.

164.name: Blood Craze
164.d: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

164.name: Piercing Howl
164.d: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

164.name: Unbridled Wrath
164.d: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

164.name: Booming Voice
164.d: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces their Rage cost by 25%.

164.name: Cruelty
164.d: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

164.name: Furious Precision
164.d: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

164.name: Raging Blows
164.d: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.

164.name: Improved Berserker Rage
164.d: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

164.name: Lingering Rage
164.d: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 10 sec.

164.name: Gore Drinker
164.d: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

181.name: Improved Eviscerate
181.d: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%.

181.name: Puncturing Wounds
181.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

181.name: Adrenaline Rush
181.d: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

181.name: Weapon Expertise
181.d: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

181.name: Hack and Slash
181.d: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.

181.name: Blade Flurry
181.d: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

181.name: Aggression
181.d: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 6%.

181.name: Improved Sprint
181.d: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

181.name: Improved Kick
181.d: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

181.name: Riposte
181.d: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

181.name: Endurance
181.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

181.name: Precision
181.d: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

181.name: Dual Wield Specialization
181.d: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25%.

181.name: Improved Sinister Strike
181.d: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

181.name: Flawless Execution
181.d: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.

182.name: Mutilate
182.d: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 17 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

182.name: Seal Fate
182.d: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

182.name: Improved Kidney Shot
182.d: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

182.name: Venom
182.d: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec

182.name: Improved Poisons
182.d: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

182.name: Vile Poisons
182.d: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

182.name: Cold Blood
182.d: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

182.name: Lethality
182.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.

182.name: Improved Expose Armor
182.d: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

182.name: Murder
182.d: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

182.name: Ruthlessness
182.d: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

182.name: Malice
182.d: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

182.name: Remorseless Attacks
182.d: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

182.name: Improved Slice and Dice
182.d: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

182.name: Improved Gouge
182.d: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

182.name: Relentless Strikes
182.d: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

183.name: Premeditation
183.d: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

183.name: Dirty Deeds
183.d: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

183.name: Preparation
183.d: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

183.name: Heightened Senses
183.d: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.

183.name: Hemorrhage
183.d: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

183.name: Improved Ambush
183.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

183.name: Cutthroat
183.d: Your Backstab has a 15% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

183.name: Setup
183.d: Gives you a 100% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

183.name: Serrated Blades
183.d: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

183.name: Elusiveness
183.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

183.name: Ghostly Strike
183.d: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

183.name: Initiative
183.d: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

183.name: Camouflage
183.d: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

183.name: Dirty Tricks
183.d: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

183.name: Opportunity
183.d: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.

183.name: Master of Deception
183.d: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.

183.name: Thousand Cuts
183.d: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.

183.name: Quietus
183.d: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 10% more damage against targets below 35% health.

183.name: Improved Distract
183.d: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 5 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 2 levels lower.

201.name: Penance
201.d: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

201.name: Renewed Hope
201.d: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

201.name: Power Infusion
201.d: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

201.name: Improved Mana Burn
201.d: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1.0 sec.

201.name: Soul Warding
201.d: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

201.name: Divine Aegis
201.d: Your non-periodic critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Shields up to (20 * 60) damage and lasts 12 sec.

201.name: Improved Inner Fire
201.d: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

201.name: Mental Agility
201.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

201.name: Meditation
201.d: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

201.name: Inner Focus
201.d: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

201.name: Martyrdom
201.d: Gives you a 100% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

201.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
201.d: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

201.name: Silent Resolve
201.d: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

201.name: Twin Disciplines
201.d: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.

201.name: Wand Specialization
201.d: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

201.name: Holy Precision
201.d: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

201.name: Power in Light
201.d: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.

202.name: Prayer of Mending
202.d: Places a spell on the target that heals them for [(172 + (Healing * 0.42899999)) * (1 * 1)] the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

202.name: Spiritual Healing
202.d: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

202.name: Spiritual Guidance
202.d: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

202.name: Spirit of Redemption
202.d: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

202.name: Litany of Light
202.d: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 10% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

202.name: Binding Heal
202.d: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 236 to 284. Low threat.

202.name: Searing Light
202.d: Increases your Holy damage done by 5%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

202.name: Improved Healing
202.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

202.name: Holy Reach
202.d: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 20%.

202.name: Inspiration
202.d: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec.

202.name: Blessed Recovery
202.d: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 25% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

202.name: Holy Nova
202.d: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 50 to 57. These effects cause no threat.

202.name: Divine Fury
202.d: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

202.name: Spell Warding
202.d: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

202.name: Improved Renew
202.d: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

202.name: Twilight Focus
202.d: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

202.name: Holy Specialization
202.d: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 5%.

203.name: Shadowform
203.d: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

203.name: Darkness
203.d: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

203.name: Devouring Contagion
203.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

203.name: Vampiric Embrace
203.d: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

203.name: Shadow Weaving
203.d: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

203.name: Dark Inspiration
203.d: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 15% for 10 sec.

203.name: Silence
203.d: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

203.name: Improved Mind Flay
203.d: Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals 20% more damage than its previous instance of damage.

203.name: Mind Flay
203.d: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

203.name: Improved Psychic Scream
203.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

203.name: Shadow Reach
203.d: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

203.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
203.d: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.

203.name: Improved Mind Blast
203.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.

203.name: Blackout
203.d: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

203.name: Spirit Tap
203.d: Gives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

203.name: Shadow Focus
203.d: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

203.name: Early Demise
203.d: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

261.name: Elemental Mastery
261.d: Gain mastery over Fire and Lightning, reducing the cast time of Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from Chain Lightning. Lasts 15 sec.

261.name: Lightning Overload
261.d: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 10% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

261.name: Lava Burst
261.d: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 114 to 145 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

261.name: Elemental Reach
261.d: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 6 yards and reduces the cooldown of Totemic Projection by 20 sec.

261.name: Earthbound
261.d: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

261.name: Eye of the Storm
261.d: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 70%.

261.name: Trial by Fire
261.d: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 4 sec, and increases the duration of your Magma Totem by 20 sec.

261.name: Elemental Warding
261.d: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 10%.

261.name: Elemental Fury
261.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

261.name: Reverberation
261.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 1.0 sec.

261.name: Elemental Focus
261.d: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

261.name: Elemental Devastation
261.d: Your Critical Strikes with direct damage spells increase your chance to get a Critical Strike with melee attacks by 9% for 10 sec.

261.name: Call of Flame
261.d: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 15%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by 9 sec.

261.name: Elemental Alacrity
261.d: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.

261.name: Concussion
261.d: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 5%.

261.name: Convection
261.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 10%.

262.name: Riptide
262.d: Heals a friendly target for 486 to 534, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

262.name: Purification
262.d: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

262.name: Nature's Swiftness
262.d: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

262.name: Healing Way
262.d: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 25%.

262.name: Mana Tide Totem
262.d: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

262.name: Tidal Focus
262.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

262.name: Restorative Totems
262.d: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 25% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 50%.

262.name: Ancestral Healing
262.d: Increases your target's armor value by 25% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

262.name: Water Shield
262.d: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

262.name: Healing Focus
262.d: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

262.name: Mindfulness
262.d: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

262.name: Totemic Focus
262.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 25%.

262.name: Natural Grace
262.d: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 15%.

262.name: Improved Reincarnation
262.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 20 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 20%.

262.name: Tidal Mastery
262.d: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 5%.

262.name: Improved Healing Wave
262.d: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.5 sec.

263.name: Rage of the Farseer
263.d: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

263.name: Maelstrom Weapon
263.d: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

263.name: Improved Stormstrike
263.d: When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 100% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

263.name: Stormstrike
263.d: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

263.name: Mental Quickness
263.d: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.

263.name: Spirit Weapons
263.d: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

263.name: Flurry
263.d: Increases your attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

263.name: Anticipation
263.d: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 6%.

263.name: Shamanistic Focus
263.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

263.name: Elemental Weapons
263.d: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 20%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 40% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 15%.

263.name: Improved Lightning Shield
263.d: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.

263.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
263.d: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

263.name: Thundering Strikes
263.d: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.

263.name: Guardian Totems
263.d: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 2 sec.

263.name: Mental Dexterity
263.d: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

263.name: Earth's Grasp
263.d: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 50% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 20%.

281.name: Ferocity
281.d: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.

281.name: Heart of the Wild
281.d: Increases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

281.name: Feral Instinct
281.d: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 30% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 3 levels higher.

281.name: Brutal Impact
281.d: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 1 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

281.name: Thick Hide
281.d: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 180 additional base Armor per level and another 2.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

281.name: Feral Swiftness
281.d: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

281.name: Feral Charge
281.d: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec. Feral Charge (Cat) 8 - 25 yd rangeInstant30 sec cooldownRequires Druid Requires level 1Requires Cat Form Leap behind an enemy.

281.name: Shredding Attacks
281.d: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 18 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 3.

281.name: Sharpened Claws
281.d: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 6%.

281.name: Blood Frenzy
281.d: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

281.name: Savage Fury
281.d: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 10%.

281.name: Primal Bite
281.d: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.

281.name: Natural Instinct
281.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.

281.name: Shifting Power
281.d: Instantly convert 0 Mana into 40 Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

281.name: Predatory Strikes
281.d: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 150% of your level.

281.name: Rend and Tear
281.d: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 10%.

281.name: Natural Reaction
281.d: Increases your dodge chance by 5%, and gives you a 100% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.

281.name: Leader of the Pack
281.d: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the melee and ranged Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%.

281.name: Berserk
281.d: Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

281.name: Improved Shifting Power
281.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Shifting Power spell by 8 sec.

282.name: Improved Tranquility
282.d: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100% and its cooldown by 60%.

282.name: Wild Growth
282.d: Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

282.name: Swiftmend
282.d: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

282.name: Improved Regrowth
282.d: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 50%.

282.name: Improved Rejuvenation
282.d: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 15%.

282.name: Tranquil Spirit
282.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by 10%.

282.name: Gift of Nature
282.d: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 10%.

282.name: Reflection
282.d: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

282.name: Gift of the Earthmother
282.d: Reduces the global cooldown by 0.5 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.

282.name: Natural Shapeshifter
282.d: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 30%.

282.name: Subtlety
282.d: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

282.name: Nature's Swiftness
282.d: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

282.name: Naturalist
282.d: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by 0.5 sec and increases all damage you deal by 5%.

282.name: Nature's Focus
282.d: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.

282.name: Furor
282.d: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 100% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 100 Energy.

283.name: Improved Wrath
283.d: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.5 sec and its Mana cost by 50%.

283.name: Genesis
283.d: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 5%.

283.name: Moonglow
283.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%.

283.name: Improved Entangling Roots
283.d: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by 75%, and its victims can take up to 75% more damage without interrupting the effect.

283.name: Nature's Majesty
283.d: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 4%.

283.name: Nature's Splendor
283.d: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.

283.name: Nature's Reach
283.d: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

283.name: Insect Swarm
283.d: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec.

283.name: Improved Moonfire
283.d: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 10%.

283.name: Vengeance
283.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 100%.

283.name: Improved Starfire
283.d: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.5 sec and Starfire has a 15% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.

283.name: Nature's Grace
283.d: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.

283.name: Eclipse
283.d: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.50 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

283.name: Moonfury
283.d: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 10%.

283.name: Moonkin Form
283.d: Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their spell Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

283.name: Overgrowth
283.d: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2.

301.name: Incinerate
301.d: Deals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

301.name: Shadow and Flame
301.d: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

301.name: Bane of Havoc
301.d: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

301.name: Fire and Brimstone
301.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

301.name: Pyroclasm
301.d: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

301.name: Agonizing Flames
301.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

301.name: Conflagrate
301.d: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

301.name: Destructive Reach
301.d: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 20%.

301.name: Intensity
301.d: Gives you a 70% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

301.name: Ruin
301.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

301.name: Shadowburn
301.d: Instantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

301.name: Aftermath
301.d: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

301.name: Cataclysm
301.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

301.name: Bane
301.d: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

301.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
301.d: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.

302.name: Wrack
302.d: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

302.name: Shadow Mastery
302.d: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 10%.

302.name: Soul Siphon
302.d: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

302.name: Siphon Life
302.d: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

302.name: Curse of Exhaustion
302.d: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

302.name: Nightfall
302.d: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

302.name: Amplify Curse
302.d: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 50%. Lasts 30 sec.

302.name: Pandemic
302.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

302.name: Fel Concentration
302.d: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

302.name: Improved Bane of Agony
302.d: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 10%.

302.name: Improved Drains
302.d: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 20%.

302.name: Improved Life Tap
302.d: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 20%.

302.name: Soul Harvest
302.d: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

302.name: Grim Reach
302.d: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

302.name: Improved Corruption
302.d: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

302.name: Suppression
302.d: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

302.name: Malevolence
302.d: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.

303.name: Demonic Pact
303.d: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

303.name: Master Demonologist
303.d: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

303.name: Soul Link
303.d: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

303.name: Demonic Knowledge
303.d: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

303.name: Improved Felhunter
303.d: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 30%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 6 sec.

303.name: Fel Domination
303.d: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 6 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

303.name: Demonic Brand
303.d: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 6 attacks against the target deal ((((60 - 26) * 1.5) + 14 + (0.078 * ((Shadow spell power)))) * (1 * 1 * 1)) to ((((60 - 26) * 1.5) + 17 + (0.078 * ((Shadow spell power)))) * (1 * 1 * 1)) Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

303.name: Decimation
303.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

303.name: Master Summoner
303.d: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

303.name: Demonic Energies
303.d: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

303.name: Demonic Sacrifice
303.d: When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

303.name: Improved Sayaad
303.d: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

303.name: Demonic Aegis
303.d: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.

303.name: Fel Vitality
303.d: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

303.name: Improved Voidwalker
303.d: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

303.name: Improved Health Funnel
303.d: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

303.name: Unholy Power
303.d: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

303.name: Improved Imp
303.d: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

361.name: Deadly Aspects
361.d: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

361.name: Bestial Wrath
361.d: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

361.name: Frenzy
361.d: Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

361.name: Bestial Discipline
361.d: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 20% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

361.name: Intimidation
361.d: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

361.name: Spirit Bond
361.d: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

361.name: Summon Hawk
361.d: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing [32 / Ferocity: 48 / Unleashed Fury: 52 + (Ranged Attack Power * (0.05))] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

361.name: Ferocity
361.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%.

361.name: Improved Mend Pet
361.d: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

361.name: Unleashed Fury
361.d: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 15%.

361.name: Bestial Swiftness
361.d: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

361.name: Improved Revive Pet
361.d: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.

361.name: Pathfinding
361.d: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

361.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
361.d: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 6%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

361.name: Focused Fire
361.d: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.

361.name: Endurance Training
361.d: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

362.name: Strider Kick
362.d: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

362.name: Resourcefulness
362.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 60%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 100% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

362.name: Lacerating Strikes
362.d: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec

362.name: Expose Prey
362.d: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 10% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.

362.name: Deterrence
362.d: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

362.name: Surefooted
362.d: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

362.name: Survival Tactics
362.d: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 10%.

362.name: Counterattack
362.d: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

362.name: Improved Wing Clip
362.d: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

362.name: Clever Traps
362.d: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

362.name: Savage Strikes
362.d: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 4%.

362.name: Entrapment
362.d: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

362.name: Improved Tracking
362.d: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.

362.name: Survivalist's Discipline
362.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.

362.name: Predator's Edge
362.d: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.

363.name: Sniper Shot
363.d: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

363.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
363.d: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.

363.name: Rapid Recuperation
363.d: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 100% when Rapid Killing is consumed.

363.name: Scatter Shot
363.d: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

363.name: Barrage
363.d: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 10%.

363.name: Mortal Shots
363.d: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

363.name: Trueshot Aura
363.d: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 30.

363.name: Rapid Killing
363.d: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.

363.name: Improved Arcane Shot
363.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

363.name: Lone Wolf
363.d: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

363.name: Careful Aim
363.d: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.

363.name: Efficiency
363.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

363.name: Lethal Attacks
363.d: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%.

363.name: Improved Concussive Shot
363.d: Gives your Concussive Shot a 20% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

363.name: Hawk Eye
363.d: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

363.name: Improved Stings
363.d: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.

381.name: Twist of Light
381.d: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, you gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

381.name: Vengeance
381.d: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 3 times.

381.name: Repentance
381.d: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

381.name: Seal of Command
381.d: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 69 to 73 Holy damage, 138 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

381.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
381.d: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

381.name: Eye for an Eye
381.d: All critical strikes against you cause 10% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

381.name: Pursuit of Justice
381.d: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

381.name: Sacred Arbiter
381.d: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

381.name: Sanctified Judgement
381.d: Gives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

381.name: Vindication
381.d: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by (3 /- 3 * 6), and increase your Attack Power by 3% for 30 sec.

381.name: Conviction
381.d: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

381.name: Holy Conduit
381.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

381.name: Improved Judgement
381.d: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 2 sec.

381.name: Benediction
381.d: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

381.name: Instrument of Law
381.d: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while Righteous Fury is not active.

381.name: Champion of the Light
381.d: Increases your spell damage by up to 30% of your Intellect.

382.name: Light's Vigil
382.d: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 175 to 189 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 326 to 344. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.

382.name: Holy Power
382.d: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.

382.name: Holy Shock
382.d: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.

382.name: Divine Precision
382.d: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

382.name: Divine Favor
382.d: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

382.name: Purifying Power
382.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 33%.

382.name: Illumination
382.d: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

382.name: Voice of Truth
382.d: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.

382.name: Unyielding Faith
382.d: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.

382.name: Healing Light
382.d: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 12%.

382.name: Improved Seals
382.d: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 15%.

382.name: Spiritual Focus
382.d: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

382.name: Reverence
382.d: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

382.name: Consecrated Ground
382.d: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

382.name: Infusion of Light
382.d: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1.0 sec.

383.name: Templar's Bulwark
383.d: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

383.name: Redoubt
383.d: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 20%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

383.name: Reckoning
383.d: Gives you a 40% chance after Blocking and a 100% chance after receiving a non-periodic critical strike to gain an extra attack. Stores up to 4 extra attacks. Cannot occur from Blocks more than once every 1.5 sec.

383.name: Holy Shield
383.d: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

383.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
383.d: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 10%.

383.name: Toughness
383.d: Increases your armor value from items by 10%.

383.name: Sacred Duty
383.d: Increases your total Stamina by 4% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by 60 sec.

383.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
383.d: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 15 sec.

383.name: Improved Righteous Fury
383.d: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 6%.

383.name: Guardian's Favor
383.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by 2 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by 6 sec.

383.name: Precision
383.d: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

383.name: Shield Specialization
383.d: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 4% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every 3 sec.

383.name: Improved Seal of Fury
383.d: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore 0 Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.

383.name: Swift Judgement
383.d: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

383.name: Iron Creed
383.d: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 25%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 10% for 6 sec.
